description: This file defines API endpoint handlers for managing API keys, including creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and verifying API keys in an Express.js application.

methods.name: getAllApiKeys
methods.description: Handles retrieval of all API keys, with support for organization-specific filtering and pagination.

methods.name: createApiKey
methods.description: Handles creation of a new API key, validating input and calling the service layer.

methods.name: updateApiKey
methods.description: Handles updating an existing API key, validating input and calling the service layer.

methods.name: deleteApiKey
methods.description: Handles deletion of an API key, requiring API key ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: verifyApiKey
methods.description: Handles verification of an API key.
